fields.title: Multicore eigenvalues fail identical-deck reproduction
fields.issue: Identical CAX8 deck with four cores produces low near-shift modes absent with one core. The one-core replica exactly restores160.1382kPa. All multicore eigenvalue runs are excluded; accepted spectra and elastic-constant sensitivities use one core. Static one/four-core campaigns agree through independent mesh checks; no source-level cause is asserted. An identical-deck one-core021b W static check is retained separately; exact endpoint comparison is in RESULTS.json.
